title: 真实搭讪，在故宫搭讪

coverage.excluded_asr_tail: S00014@35.63-37.63 ends 0.779932 seconds after the audited 36.850068-second media duration and is excluded in full from timeline, claims and evidence.

timeline.summary: The first-person camera follows and approaches a woman in the Forbidden City plaza; the opening speech is too unclear to support a claim.
The camera-holder greets her, says he wants to meet her and says he finds her attractive.
The woman checks whether he wants to add WeChat, he confirms, and they present phones for what appears to be a scan or contact exchange. The device state is not readable.
He asks where she is going, she says she is going to buy water, and the in-bounds transcript records an OK and goodbye.
The media closes after the goodbye. S00014 is excluded because its timestamp extends beyond the audited media duration, so this interval supplies no additional dialogue claim.

claims.speaker: male_camera_holder_unconfirmed
claims.statement: The camera-holder clearly states that he wants to meet the woman and gives a direct appearance-based compliment.
claims.conditions: This is an observed line in one edited encounter, not proof that the line caused cooperation; his identity is not independently authenticated.

claims.speaker: woman_and_male_camera_holder
claims.statement: The woman verbally clarifies that he wants to add WeChat, and the two then hold phones together in an apparent scan attempt.
claims.conditions: The screens are unreadable; this does not prove a saved contact, attraction, informed filming consent or later interaction.

examples.summary: A public approach progresses from an explicit wish to meet, through mutual clarification about WeChat, to phone handling and a short logistical close.

speaker_attribution.speaker: male_camera_holder_unconfirmed
speaker_attribution.basis: Male speech aligns with the first-person camera and hands, but no reviewed frame independently identifies him as Mikey.

speaker_attribution.speaker: woman
speaker_attribution.basis: The visible woman speaks while facing the camera-holder; exact turn boundaries around S00006-S00010 remain partly automatic.

visual_findings: All twelve sampled frames and all thirty-seven one-second dense frames were reviewed.
The woman is identifiable in a public tourist site and visibly holds her phone during the exchange.
The camera-holder brings a phone close to hers, but no readable screen confirms a saved contact or account identity.

permissions.reason: Distinct edited case only; identity, publication consent, device result and later outcome are unverified, and S00014 overruns the media.

limitations: S00014 is excluded in full because its end time exceeds the media duration; it is not used as dialogue evidence or in any claim.
The opening S00001-S00002 is too unclear for semantic use.
An apparent QR or phone scan does not establish that the contact was saved or voluntarily used later.
Visible identity and an unverified filming/publication context create privacy concerns.
One-second visual review is not continuous original audio-visual verification.
